summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Saved watchlists not persisting  ### What I did (read-only audit, no edits made) I traced the full path: `WatchlistPage.tsx` → `api.ts` → `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` → `db/auth.ts` / `db/index.ts`, plus the auth middleware and session/cookie logic. Contrary to the ticket's hypothesis, **I could not find an obvious client-side wiring bug in the current code**:  - Backend (`modules/watchlist/handlers.ts`) correctly scopes every read/write by `user_id` derived from the session (`GET /`, `GET /:id`, `POST /:id/items`, `DELETE /:id/items/:itemId` all filter/verify
